reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM products p
  WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id
    AND p.unit_cost_eur > 500
)
alternatives:
SELECT category_id, category_name
FROM categories
WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE unit_cost_eur > 500)

SELECT DISTINCT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE p.unit_cost_eur > 500

other_way.sql:
SELECT category_id, category_name
FROM categories
WHERE category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM products WHERE unit_cost_eur > 500)
other_way.tradeoff: IN with a list of category IDs reads just as well here; only NOT IN trips over missing values.
